authority: Current PI instruction, using previous GT midpoint/envelope methodology for repeat-annotated events. Supersedes earlier preparation-only prohibition on automatic averaging for this conditional GT construction.
original_36: Preserve exact existing adjudicated final values and original provenance.
new_60_single_pass: Final center/earliest/latest = primary annotation, explicitly PRIMARY_ONLY with cohort repeatability audit qualification.
new_24_repeat: If no adjudication required: final center = midpoint of restored Pass1/Pass2 centers; earliest = minimum human earliest; latest = maximum human latest. Preserve both complete annotations.
review_gate: Stop for uncertainty, missing/invalid bounds, explicit difficulty/notes needing review, interval width >=5ms (existing routing rule), nonoverlapping plausible intervals, or disagreement beyond previous pilot demonstrated <=2ms envelope. This is a conservative adjudication trigger, not a claimed accuracy threshold. Review overall and grouped repeatability before construction.
precision: 1ms interface marker steps; fractional restored coordinates and midpoints do not establish sub-millisecond human accuracy.
target: Channel-specific observable onset in the Fishman Full Circle pickup signal; NOT physical string-release Ground Truth.
